name: EPIC 220662169
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 8.8 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220662169 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.785368 (16th-84th percentiles 8.584496-9.082268), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220662169: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4513.8916 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

text.card: A red giant 1,177 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.93 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,514 K at its surface.
